title: Provision a workspace user
summary: Create a workspace account for a new hire (email, drive, groups).

parts.title: Create the workspace user (email, profile)
parts.guidance: Use the onboarding request to verify the person, manager, start date and account name. Check for an existing identity before creating a profile, mailbox or license. Provision through the workspace administrator’s authorized process and deliver activation instructions securely. Coordinate activation with the start conditions so the right person receives one usable company account at the intended time.

execution.rationale: Google Workspace's Admin console documents checking and creating the approved user's identity, mailbox and license and delivering activation instructions.

parts.title: Add the user to groups and shared drives
parts.guidance: Match the person’s responsibilities to the groups and shared drives they need. Check inherited permissions with group owners, especially for personnel, finance or customer information, before adding membership. Verify essential resources are reachable and resolve exceptional access separately. Assign any temporary or unusual permission a review owner so it can be removed when the work changes.

execution.rationale: Google documents group-member administration and shared-drive membership. Apply the approved role mapping in both places and check inherited access with the resource owners.

parts.title: Provision app access from the identity provider (SSO/SCIM)
parts.guidance: Check which requested applications support the identity provider’s configured sign-in and provisioning methods. Apply the app owners’ access decisions through the identity administrator, then inspect the resulting accounts and roles in the target applications. Resolve failed provisioning, duplicate identities and missing licenses individually. An assigned group is only an input; the person needs the intended access in the application itself.

execution.rationale: Target-app accounts and roles depend on the configured identity-provider connectors and supported provisioning methods.

parts.title: New hire signs in and enrolls MFA
parts.guidance: Give the employee the activation route and support contact. They sign in, replace any temporary credential and enroll the authentication methods required by company policy, keeping passwords and recovery secrets private. Check that the intended workspace is accessible and that the employee understands the recovery process. Route enrollment or device failures to the administrator who can resolve them.

execution.rationale: The new hire personally signs in, replaces temporary credentials and enrolls their authentication methods.

metadata.supportReason: Workspace directory APIs expose user provisioning — an agent can create the account; access grants stay approval-gated.
